ja: • EF200形は、1992年から量産され東海道・山陽本線で使用を開始。開発当時は最強の6000kw出力・1600t牽引を目指したが、変電所の構造上の問題で実現せず、出力を制限して運用。
• EF210形は、EF65形・EF66形の後継機として、また東海道・山陽本線の1300tコンテナ貨物列車運転拡大に充当する目的で開発。JR初の愛称が採用された機関車で、公募の結果「ECO-POWER 桃太郎」と命名。
• EF200形・電気機関車（新塗装）１両とEF210形・電気機関車１両入り。
・動力ユニット1対応・2両入り
en: • The EF200 type was mass produced in 1992 and started being used on the Tokaido/Sanyo Main Line. At the time of development, the aim was to have the strongest output of 6,000kw and tow 1,600 tons, but due to structural problems with the substation, this was not possible and the output was limited.

• The EF210 type was developed as a successor to the EF65 and EF66 types, and to be used to expand the operation of 1300t container freight trains on the Tokaido/Sanyo Main Line. This is JR's first locomotive to be given a nickname, and it is named "ECO-POWER Momotaro" after a public contest.
• Contains one EF200 type electric locomotive (new paint) and one EF210 type electric locomotive.
